move: Fix seven published scenario links that used unowned params (price=/rate=/years= instead of pp=/mr=/th=), and add scenario-links.test.ts to guard the query-string contract across all published copy.
rationale: Scenario links are the intended distribution asset for phase D, so a broken one fails exactly where nobody is watching. The seventh, in when-does-buying-beat-renting, told the reader to load a 4% rate to see a year-6 break-even but loaded 6.5% and showed none - the site contradicting itself on a page whose value is checkable math.
predicted_effect: No ranking effect expected and none should be attributed. This is a correctness precondition for D: pasted scenario links now load the scenario they claim. Success is the guard staying green and D's links resolving correctly.
outcome: 10 of 10 published scenario links now use owned params; guard added; 101 tests green, audit 13/13, deployed ad7bf2e5.
